svg.title: ToF scanning and camera-based object detection
svg.desc: The Raspberry Pi produces object boxes, classes and confidence scores internally, then calculates centres and colour. Its serial payload to the Arduino contains image width, image height, centre X, centre Y and colour. The Arduino estimates target heading and approach distance and controls driving and grasping. Classes and confidence are not transmitted. The alternative ToF branch supplies range measurements from the servo-swept sensor.
